attribution: 出典：国土交通省 不動産情報ライブラリ (https://www.reinfolib.mlit.go.jp/), 不動産取引価格情報 (Real estate transaction price information, Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism), used under the Public Data License v1.0 (CC BY 4.0 compatible). Quarterly medians per m² by city and ward were computed here from the survey records (processed by us; not produced or endorsed by the Ministry).
basis: MLIT transaction price information (survey of registered sales): quarterly median price per m² of used condominiums, all transactions in the city or ward pooled; a median of raw transactions, so mix of flats sold and survey response move it. Detached houses (land with building) per m² of floor area as a segment (or as the city series where condominium sales are too thin, labelled)
name: Nagano
notes: Nagano: the city series is the median price per m² of detached houses (land with building, per m² of floor area; condominium sales are too thin here for a series of 32 or more quarters) among all MLIT survey transactions in the municipality; 0 地区名 districts (the publisher's district names, grouped as published) have at least 15 records a quarter for 32+ quarters. Quarter = the transaction quarter. Cells under 20 (city), 15 (ward) or 15 (district) transactions are dropped and each series cut to its longest unbroken run, so none is interpolated. The latest quarters are held back until the pooled count of the 21 designated areas has caught up. These are medians of raw transactions from a survey that covers a minority of sales: the mix of flats or houses sold (age, size, station distance) and the response rate move them, and no quality adjustment is made.
